title: 第一卷 第9章 外公外婆的支持
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

柳家村在沈家村东边，只隔了一道山梁，翻过去就到。

沈鹿溪天还没亮就出了门，走的是山里的小路，要比官道近了将近一半。

柳荞娘嫁到沈家以后，王桂花不让她跟娘家走动，说什么“嫁出去的女儿泼出去的水”，逢年过节都不许她回去。

柳家那边也不是没来找过，可每次上门都被王桂花拦在院门外，骂骂咧咧的撵走。

来了几回，柳老爹气得拍桌子，说再也不踏进沈家的门，两边就这么断了。

沈鹿溪前世直到逃难的时候才见到外公外婆，那时候两个老人已经瘦得脱了相，没能撑过那年冬天。

这辈子不会再这样了。

翻过山梁，柳家村就出现在了眼前。

比沈家村小了一圈，二三十户人家沿着山脚散开，村口有一棵老槐树，树下拴着头黄牛，正甩着尾巴赶苍蝇。

沈鹿溪沿着村路往里走，有村民认出了她。

“这不是荞娘家的闺女吗？好些年没见，都长这么大了。”

沈鹿溪笑着喊了声嫂子，没多停留，径直往村子里走。

柳家的院子在村尾，篱笆墙围着三间土坯房，院子里晾着几张兽皮，墙根底下靠着两把弓和一捆箭。

院门开着，一个头发花白的老头正在院子里蹲着磨刀。

细看是把猎刀，有巴掌宽，磨得锃亮。

老头身板还很硬朗，肩膀宽厚，虽然头发白了大半，但蹲在那里的身形依然稳当。

这是柳老爹。

沈鹿溪站在院门口，喊了一声：“外公。”

柳老爹磨刀的手停了下来。

他抬起头，眯着眼看了看院门口站着的人，愣了好一会。

“鹿溪？”他犹豫着开口。

“外公，是我。”沈鹿溪回答。

柳老爹猛地站起身来，磨刀石差点踢翻了。

他三步并作两步走到院门口，上上下下打量了沈鹿溪好几遍，嘴唇抖了抖。

“你咋来了？你奶那个老婆子让你来的？”

“不是，我自己来的。”沈鹿溪看着柳老爹的眼睛说。

柳老爹的眼眶一下就红了，赶快扭过头去，擦了一把脸，装作没事人的样子，朝着屋内喊了一嗓子：“老婆子！快出来，鹿溪来了！”

屋里传来了一阵响动，柳婆子从灶房里跑了出来，手上还沾着面粉。

一看见沈鹿溪，眼泪当场就掉了下来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Liujia Village is to the east of Shenjia Village, separated only by a mountain ridge. You can reach it by climbing over it.

Shen Luxi went out before dawn and took a path in the mountains, which was nearly half the distance from the official road.

After Liu Qiaoniang married into the Shen family, Wang Guihua did not allow her to go with her parents' family, saying that "the married daughter threw water", and she was not allowed to go back during the holidays.

It's not like the Liu family hasn't come looking for her, but every time she comes, Wang Guihua stops her outside the courtyard gate and kicks her away with curses.

After coming a few times, Father Liu was so angry that he slapped the table and said that he would never step into the Shen family's door again, and the two sides were just broken.

In Shen Luxi's previous life, she didn't see her grandparents until they were fleeing. By then, the two old people were so thin that they lost their looks and couldn't survive that winter.

It won't happen again in this life.

After crossing the mountain ridge, Liujia Village appeared in front of us.

A circle smaller than Shenjia Village, twenty or thirty households are spread out along the foot of the mountain. There is an old locust tree at the entrance of the village. Under the tree, a yellow ox is tied, waving its tail to chase away flies.

As Shen Luxi walked along the village road, a villager recognized her.

"Isn't this the daughter of Qiao Niang's family? I haven't seen her for many years, and she has grown so big."

Shen Luxi smiled and called her sister-in-law, and walked straight to the village without stopping.

The Liu family's yard is at the end of the village. There are three adobe houses surrounded by fences. Several animal skins are drying in the yard, and two bows and a bundle of arrows are leaning against the base of the wall.

The courtyard door was open, and an old man with gray hair was squatting in the courtyard sharpening a knife.

If you look closely, it's a hunting knife, as wide as a hand, and polished to a bright finish.

The old man still has a strong body and broad shoulders. Although his hair is mostly gray, his figure is still stable when he squats there.

This is Dad Liu.

Shen Luxi stood at the entrance of the courtyard and called: "Grandpa."

Father Liu stopped sharpening his knife.

He raised his head, squinted at the person standing at the entrance of the courtyard, and was stunned for a while.

"Deer Creek?" he said hesitantly.

"Grandpa, it's me." Shen Luxi replied.

Father Liu stood up suddenly and almost kicked over the whetstone.

He walked to the courtyard door in three steps and two steps at a time. He looked up and down at Shen Luxi several times and his lips trembled.

"Why are you here? Your old lady asked you to come?"

"No, I came here by myself." Shen Luxi looked into Father Liu's eyes and said.

Father Liu's eyes suddenly turned red. He quickly turned his head, wiped his face, pretended to be fine, and shouted into the house: "Old lady! Come out quickly, Luxi is coming!"

There was a noise in the house, and Mrs. Liu ran out of the kitchen, her hands still stained with flour.

As soon as he saw Shen Luxi, tears fell on the spot.
